noSourcesYet: No sources yet. Add a repository, then install a source from it.
removeSourceMessage: Its series stay in your library but cannot be read until you install it again.
pasteSourceHint: Paste the text of a source. It is checked before anything is kept.
replacesSource: This replaces the {name} installed from {origin}. A pasted source does not update itself, and the repository no longer updates it.
sourceDisclaimer: Akidev does not include, offer or endorse any source. Only add one you trust: it decides which sites the app contacts.
addRepositoryMessage: Enter the address of a repository folder on GitHub, or of any web folder that lists sources.
repositoryPreviewSigned: Signed, so the app notices if it changes hands.
repositoryPreviewNotSigned: Not signed. You are trusting this address.
repositoryDisclaimer: Akidev does not include, offer or endorse any repository. Only add one you trust.
repositoriesFooter: A repository is a folder of sources, usually on GitHub. Paste its address. Akidev does not include, offer or endorse any. Only add repositories you trust: a source decides which sites the app contacts.
noRepositoriesYet: No repositories yet. Add one to find sources.
repositorySigned: This repository is signed, so the app notices if it changes hands.
repositoryNotSigned: This repository is not signed. You are trusting its address.
booksFooter: Add an EPUB from your device, or a catalogue of books by its address (an OPDS feed). Akidev does not include, offer or endorse any catalogue. Books are read in the Books tab and stay on this phone.
addCatalogueMessage: Enter the address of an OPDS catalogue, for example a Calibre-Web or Standard Ebooks feed.
signInDetails: Your details go to {host} only. Akidev keeps a session, not your password.
couldNotLoadSignIn: Could not load the sign-in form. Close this and try again.
